name: stn-ultradesign
description: AI UI/UX design skill for application audits, distinctive design systems, interactive concepts and implementation guided by your requirements.

interface.shortDescription: Your product. Your design direction. A complete UI/UX workflow.
interface.longDescription: Turn product requirements into a coherent experience. Audit existing interfaces, translate your brand into shared components, map features through the redesign, review interactive concepts, and verify implementation against the agreed design.
defaultPrompt: Audit the entire frontend of this existing application using its current source code and running interface. Ask me about my requirements and design preferences, preserve existing capabilities, and develop a complete interactive design concept. Clarify which earlier design decisions still apply. Independently review and refine the concept with me. Implement production changes only after my approval.
Audit the entire frontend and document findings, evidence, and coverage.
Develop a complete design concept from requirements and creative direction through the component system, independent review and my scoped acceptance.
Implement the approved concept and verify behavior and visual fidelity.
